task: D03 演示稿与分页预览
description: outline -> python-pptx deck -> LibreOffice PDF -> pdftocairo pages + preview.json + manifest.json
pipeline: page outline first (max 30; overflow recorded, never silently trimmed) with per-page kc_ citations
python-pptx 1.0.2 writes the deck (native charts, speaker-note citations, trailing sources slide, fonts >= 12pt)
LibreOffice impress headless (libreoffice-impress-nogui 7.4.7) renders report.pdf under a timeout budget; budget kill -> render=failed
pdfinfo page count must equal slide count; pdftotext per page must carry the key strings; pdftocairo -f N -l N exports every page to pages/page-N.svg
python-pptx readback checks boundaries (shapes inside the slide box), font floor and declared images -> pages check
preview.json + static index.html viewer (thumbnails/prev-next/page number/downloads/ArrowLeft-ArrowRight/modify postMessage) + manifest.json

toolchain.python_pptx: 1.0.2 (MIT license; sha256-pinned wheel over Debian lxml/Pillow)
toolchain.xlsxwriter: 3.2.0 (BSD license; python-pptx chart-data dependency, sha256-pinned wheel)
toolchain.fonts_cjk: fonts-noto-cjk 1:20220127+repack1-1 (SIL Open Font License 1.1; from the D02 set)

forbidden: shipping a PPTX without the rendered PDF + every page image
silently dropping pages beyond the 30-page cap (record overflow_pages instead)
claiming visual aesthetics as passed (visual stays not_run for human acceptance)

modify_channel.contract: the static viewer's 修改此页 button posts {type: 'craft:slides:modify', page: N} to window.parent; the assembly attaches the current version id and forwards the explicit page number to the main agent

example.deck: 5 页客户方案（长中文标题/中文正文/原生柱状图/来源页）
example.render: impress_pdf_Export -> 5 页 PDF；pdftotext 逐页命中中文关键词；pdftocairo 逐页导出 57-105KB SVG
example.modify: 只改第 3 页结论 -> 其余 slide XML 字节不变，页数一致，旧版本 PPTX/PDF 原 SHA
example.overflow: 31 页大纲 -> overflow_pages [31]，pages=failed，反馈主 Agent 拆分
example.fixtures: internal/craft/testdata/d03_python_pptx_deck.pptx + d03_libreoffice_render.pdf + d03_pdftocairo_page1.svg (produced by this exact image run)

verification: one-shot acceptance container reproducing the render/overflow/budget proofs (see task-D03-report.md)
